name: ANOVA designs and random-intercept REML (Python)
description: I/II/III sums of squares, block/split-plot/repeated-measures error strata, single random-intercept REML, and equal-weight marginal means in numpy/scipy/pandas; validated against R stats, car 3.1-5, nlme 3.1-169 and emmeans 2.0.4, with numerical optimization differences documented.

inputs.name: data
inputs.format: observation-level table with response, categorical factors and experimental-unit IDs

inputs.name: design
inputs.format: factorial design metadata or a full-rank numeric model matrix with explicit factor levels

outputs: per-stratum and Type I/II/III SS, df, MS, F, p and denominators
OLS/REML coefficients, covariance, variance components and diagnostics
equal-weight marginal means, covariance, SE and confidence intervals
